description:
List this account's recent lessons (use when someone asks "my videos", "what did I make", or wants to continue an earlier one)

Use when the user refers to their own earlier work: their videos, the lesson they started yesterday, the one waiting for approval. Returns the newest lessons with id, title, status, minutes and a link to open each. Read-only and free. Pass `status` to narrow (queued | rendering | done | failed) and `limit` (default 20, max 50).
name: list_lessons
